description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between accuracy and the o_pop frequency (scaled by 10^4) for two metrics: Initial Accuracy and Final Accuracy. The x-axis, labeled "o_pop frequency (x10^4)", spans from 1 to 19 with a linear scale, while the y-axis, labeled "Accuracy", ranges from 0.0 to 1.0. The green line with square markers, representing Initial Accuracy, begins at an accuracy of approximately 0.35 at an o_pop frequency of 1, rises to a peak of about 0.5 at a frequency of 5, dips to a low of roughly 0.3 at a frequency of 7, and then trends upward to a final value of approximately 0.42 at a frequency of 19. The blue dashed line with circular markers, representing Final Accuracy, starts at an accuracy of about 0.65 at an o_pop frequency of 1, fluctuates with a peak of approximately 0.92 at a frequency of 9, and ends at a value of around 0.9 at a frequency of 19. Error bars are present for both lines, indicating variability in the measurements.
